BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

3. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.

4. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Doors.

5. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.

6. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

7. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.

8. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.

9. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

10. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.

11. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

13. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

14. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

16. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Site Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Appropriate Technology in Building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
